description:
Job Title: Power Platform Developer/Engineer 
 
Job Category: Information Technology 
 
Time Type: Full time 
 
Minimum Clearance Required to Start: None 
 
Employee Type: Regular 
 
Percentage of Travel Required: Up to 10% 
 
Type of Travel: Local 
 
 
* * * 
 
 
 The Opportunity: 
 We are seeking an in‑person, senior‑level Power Platform Developer/Engineer based in Northern Virginia office. The ideal candidate will have experience delivering end‑to‑end solution architecture and development using Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI, and applied AI capabilities.
 This role will provide technical leadership, architectural design expertise, and hands‑on development across our enterprise modernization and data initiatives. Beyond solution delivery, a key focus will be shaping the technical strategy for our Power Platform ecosystem—ensuring scalable, secure, and resilient architectures that support mission‑critical operations.

 

 Responsibilities: 
 Application Development :  Independently d esign , architect,   and   fully   build custom   solutions   using   the   Microsoft Power Platform   suite of tools , including   PowerFX ,   Canvas   apps   with SharePoint lists.   Ensure applications are intuitive,   scalable,   maintainable,   and meet   stakeholder needs .   Integrate securely with enterprise data sources . U tilize CSS   and HTML   to   improve layout, content   presentation   and   enhance user interfaces.      
   

 
 Workflows and Automation :   D esign, test, and   maintain   sophisticated   Power Automate workflows   for   stand-alone solutions or in conjunction with Power App solutions to automate business critical processes. Familiarity with standard vs premium connectors, loops and complex workflow logic,   and  failure /error handling.    

 
 Data Visualization:  Develop and   maintain   dynamic dashboards and reports using Power BI to support data-driven insights. Utilize advanced report design, DAX, and Power Query to create meaningful visualizations.   

 
 AI Integration:  Integrate   or develop   AI capabilities   such as AI Hub, CoPilot Studio, AI Models, or AI Agents   into business processes for automation and efficiency. Leverage AI models and tools to enhance   workflows and   solution capabilities , collaborating with CACI’s AI product team .   

 
 Solution Architecture :  Work closely with stakeholders and teammates to   own the solution   development process. This includes   elicit   and document   requirements, design data   architecture and   flows, develop, test, and deliver   individual   solutions , keeping the larger enterprise architecture in mind .   This includes creating SharePoint sites, lists, and permissions as part of the solution.   Ensure   full   solutions are user-friendly and align with business goals.   

 
 Enterprise   Technical   Architecture :   Work with the development teams to   support   end-to-end   enterprise   architecture for Power Platform solutions, including application design patterns, data architecture, security models, API strategy, and enterprise integration approaches .   

 
 Process Analysis:  Analyze business processes,   utilize   generative AI, and develop tools, reports, or other solutions to meet the business needs. Translate complex business requirements into solutions.   Serve as technical advisor to stakeholders; translate   high ‑ complexity   business needs into   multi ‑ component   architectures and implementation roadmaps   

 
 Governance,   Standards   & Best Practices :  Adhere to team standards and governance principles, including styles, documentation, and configuration management.   Provide enhancement ideas to the team’s   Power Platform governance models, including environment strategy, ALM/DevOps pipelines, baselines, and   other team operations.   Ensure all development is well-documented and follows best practices.   Partner with   and mentor   other   developers on architecture, coding practices, automation logic, and solution design .   

 
 Operational Support:  Provide operational support for deployed solutions, addressing any issues or enhancements required post-deployment.   Analyze complex issues, performing root cause analysis and recommend remediation for long-term platform and solution health.   

 
 Training and Documentation:   Maintain   comprehensive documentation. Support training efforts to   facilitate   user adoption across teams and to ensure users are well-versed in   utilizing   new solutions .   

 
 Continuous Learning:  Stay current on Microsoft Power Platform, SharePoint, AI tools, and industry best practices. Be willing to learn   new technologies   and incorporate them into solutions as needed.   
 

 Qualifications: 
 Required:  

 Must be a U.S. Citizen    

 
 5 +   years   proven experience with   designing ,   architecting , and developing   enterprise solutions using the Microsoft Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI,   PowerFX , and SharePoint ) and Microsoft 365 ecosystem   

 
 Proven experience owning solution architecture—data modeling, integration strategy, application patterns, and security design     

 

 Experience with data   analysis, DAX   optimization , Power Query, and advanced   PowerBI   modeling,   design   and development   

 
 UI/UX Graphic design experience   for custom applications   

 
 Experience with connecting to varied data sources    

 
 Experience with CoPilot   Studio   and AI integration with   PowerPlatform   Solutions   

 
 Proven ability to   quickly   translate business needs into scalable, user-friendly solutions   

 
 Ability to lead technical reviews,   establish   engineering standards, and mentor teams   

 
 Excellent communication, documentation, problem-solving, analysis, collaboration , and stakeholder-facing   skills   

 
 Familiarity with low-code/no-code AI models,   Robotic Process Automation ( RPA ) , or machine learning tools (e.g., AI Builder)   and principles with application in business solutions   

 

 



 Desired: 
 ProCode   experience    

 
 Experience   using   CodeApps   

 
 Experience with   custom API Connections   utilizing   REST APIs   

 
 Demonstrated experience modernizing legacy processes or systems into scalable   enterprise solutions   

 
 Experience integrating or   leveraging   AI tools such as Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock or other cloud-based AI services   

 
 Experience with Microsoft Power Platform governance and Center of Excellence practices   

 
 Microsoft certification(s) in Power Platform (e.g., PL-100, PL-200, PL-300 ,   PL-400,   PL-900 )   

 
 Familiarity or experience with   Dataverse, SQL, AWS   

 
 Familiarity with   PowerPages   

 
 Experience working in   Federal or G overnment   Contracting industry   or regulated environments   

 
 
 
- 
 
 What You Can Expect: 
  A culture of integrity. 
 At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose – to ensure the safety of our nation.
 An environment of trust. 
 CACI values the unique contributions that every employee brings to our company and our customers - every day. You’ll have the autonomy to take the time you need through a unique flexible time off benefit and have access to robust learning resources to make your ambitions a reality.
 A focus on continuous growth. 
 Together, we will advance our nation's most critical missions, build on our lengthy track record of business success, and find opportunities to break new ground — in your career and in our legacy.
 
 

 Pay Range : 
 There are a host of factors that can influence final salary including, but not limited to, geographic location, Federal Government contract labor categories and contract wage rates, relevant prior work experience, specific skills and competencies, education, and certifications. Our employees value the flexibility at CACI that allows them to balance quality work and their personal lives. We offer competitive compensation, benefits and learning and development opportunities. Our broad and competitive mix of benefits options is designed to support and protect employees and their families. At CACI, you will receive comprehensive benefits such as; healthcare, wellness, financial, retirement, family support, continuing education, and time off benefits.
 
 The proposed salary range for this position is: 
$113,200 - $237,800 
 
 
 
 CACI is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected characteristic.
